test_title: SSC CPO Tier-II Previous Year Paper (Held On: 8th November 2021)
subject: general
question: Which statement is NOT true about ‘Hortus Malabaricus’?

options.text: It is a 12-volume treatise, written in Latin.
Many languages like Malayalam, Konkani and Arabic appear in the book.
It gives a comprehensive account of the life in the Malabar region.
It was a product of a multinational and multicultural team of botanical experts.

solution:
The correct answer is** 'It gives a comprehensive account of the life in the Malabar region.'**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• Let's have a look at the second sentence of the first paragraph of the passage: 

 
 
• *' *The first book in which Malayalam appears in print is the ‘Hortus Malabaricus’ (Garden of Malabar), a 12-volume treatise, written in Latin and published in Amsterdam from 1678 to1693.*'*
